props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Manually unmounts the autocomplete. Call this after any externally controlled closing animation finishes.

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Whether the first matching item is highlighted automatically. - `true`: highlight after the user types and keep the highlight while the query changes. - `'always'`: always highlight the first item.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is initially open. To render a controlled popup, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled input value of the autocomplete when it's initially rendered. To render a controlled autocomplete, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: filter
props.type: ((itemValue: unknown, query: string, itemToString?: ((itemValue: unknown) => string)) => …
props.typeFull: ((itemValue: unknown, query: string, itemToString?: ((itemValue: unknown) => string)) => boolean) | null
props.description: Filter function used to match items vs input query.

props.name: filteredItems
props.description: Filtered items to display in the list. When provided, the list will use these items instead of filtering the `items` prop internally. Use when you want to control filtering logic externally with the `useFilter()` hook.

props.name: form
props.description: Identifies the form that owns the internal input. Useful when the autocomplete is rendered outside the form.

props.name: grid
props.description: Whether list items are presented in a grid layout. When enabled, arrow keys navigate across rows and columns inferred from DOM rows.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the component.

props.name: inline
props.description: Whether the list is rendered inline without using the component's own popup. Specify `open` unconditionally in conjunction with this prop so the list is considered visible: `<Autocomplete.Root inline open>`

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to the hidden input element.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to be displayed in the list. Can be either a flat array of items or an array of groups with items.

props.name: itemToStringValue
props.description: When the item values are objects (`<Autocomplete.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for both display in the input and form submission. If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the label will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.

props.name: keepHighlight
props.description: Whether the highlighted item should be preserved when the pointer leaves the list.

props.name: limit
props.description: The maximum number of items to display in the list.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale to use for string comparison. Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the input when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys. The first item can then be reached by pressing <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> again from the input, or the last item can be reached by pressing <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> from the input. The input is always included in the focus loop per [ARIA Authoring Practices](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/). When disabled, focus does not move when on the last element and the user presses <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>, or when on the first element and the user presses <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd>.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the popup enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to the popup: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed. On touch devices, a `true` modal blocks outside taps but leaves the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width, matching native iOS behavior.

props.name: mode
props.description: Controls how the autocomplete behaves with respect to list filtering and inline autocompletion. - `list` (default): items are dynamically filtered based on the input value. The input value does not change based on the active item. - `both`: items are dynamically filtered based on the input value, which will temporarily change based on the active item (inline autocompletion). - `inline`: items are static (not filtered), and the input value will temporarily change based on the active item (inline autocompletion). - `none`: items are static (not filtered), and the input value will not change based on the active item.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: onItemHighlighted
props.description: Callback fired when an item is highlighted or unhighlighted. Receives the highlighted item value (or `undefined` if no item is highlighted) and event details with a `reason` property describing why the highlight changed. The `reason` can be: - `'keyboard'`: the highlight changed due to keyboard navigation. - `'pointer'`: the highlight changed due to pointer hovering. - `'none'`: the highlight changed programmatically.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the popup is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the popup is opened or closed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Event handler called when the input value of the autocomplete changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is currently open. Use when controlled.

props.name: openOnInputClick
props.description: Whether the popup opens when clicking the input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to choose a different option from the popup.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: submitOnItemClick
props.description: Whether clicking an item should submit the autocomplete's owning form. By default, clicking an item via a pointer or <kbd>Enter</kbd> key does not submit the owning form. Useful when the autocomplete is used as a single-field form search input.

props.name: value
props.description: The input value of the autocomplete. Use when controlled.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Whether the items are being externally virtualized.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether the component should remain mounted in the DOM when not visible.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: items
props.description: Items to be rendered within this group. When provided, child `Collection` components will use these items.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: index
props.description: The index of the item in the list. Improves performance when specified by avoiding the need to calculate the index automatically from the DOM.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: onClick
props.description: An optional click handler for the item when selected. It fires when clicking the item with the pointer, as well as when pressing `Enter` with the keyboard if the item is highlighted when the `Input` or `List` element has focus.

props.name: value
props.description: A unique value that identifies this item.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void…
props.typeFull: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the popup is closed. - `false`: Do not move focus. - `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element). - `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element. - `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`). Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => boolean | void …
props.typeFull: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the popup is opened. - `false`: Do not move focus. - `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (first tabbable element or popup). - `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element. - `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`). Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.name: container
props.type: HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | RefObject<HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | null> | null
props.description: A parent element to render the portal element into.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment. The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties: - `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against. - `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | …
props.typeFull: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null) | null
props.description: An element to position the popup against. By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup. Use it to prevent the arrow element from hanging out of the rounded corners of a popup.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup. `side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`): - `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side (`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`). - `'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within the clipping boundary so it stays visible. - `'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow. `align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`): - `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows. - `'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the alignment axis to fit. - `'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow. `fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the preferred axis cannot fit: - `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first (`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR). - `'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first (`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR). - `'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis. When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`. If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment. The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties: - `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`. - `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against. - `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the separator.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).
